text:
Give truth tables that show that the following are not tautologies
  of~$\LogGod[3]$
  \begin{align*}
    & (p \lif q) \lif (\lnot p \lor q) \\
    & \lnot(\lnot p \land \lnot q) \lif (p \lor q) \\
    & ((p \lif q) \lif p) \lif p \\
    & \lnot(p \lif q) \lif (p \land \lnot q)
  \end{align*}
